notes: Two isnads for one saying: the first («حدثنا يحيى بن بكير») is followed by «وحدثني محمد بن مقاتل», so each is its own group (rule 4); the matn comes after the second
«عبد الله هو ابن المبارك» is an editor's gloss; the surface is «عبد الله»; «عروة» and «عائشة» occur twice, so occurrences 1 and 2 are used
